forms.subject: Person reporting an address change

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
What was your previous physical address?
fields.help: Include street, unit, city, state or province, postal code, and country.

fields.label: What is your new physical address?
fields.help: Use the place where you now live.

fields.label: Where should you receive mail?
fields.help: If it is the same as your new physical address, enter that address again.

fields.label: When did you move?

forms.subject: Applicant or petitioner requesting receipt notifications

fields.label: What is the applicant or petitioner's full legal name?
Which forms are in the application package?
fields.help: List form names only, such as I-130 or I-485. Do not enter receipt numbers.

fields.label: Which email should receive notifications?
fields.help: Use a sample email for this draft preview; no notification will be sent.

fields.label: Which phone should receive text notifications?
fields.help: Use a sample U.S. mobile number for this draft preview; no text will be sent.

fields.label: Would you prefer email, text, or both?
fields.help: This is a draft preference. The official notification request can use the contact options it supports.

forms.subject: Requester and the person whose immigration records are sought

fields.label: What is the requester's full name?
Whose immigration records are you requesting?
fields.help: Enter that person's full legal name, even if it is your own.

fields.label: What is that person's date of birth?
What is your relationship to that person?
fields.help: For your own records, enter Self. Requests about another person may need consent or other authorization.

fields.label: Which records would you like to request?
fields.help: Describe the documents or time period. Do not include identification or case numbers in this preview.

fields.label: What is the requester's mailing address?
What email should be used for this draft request?

forms.subject: Permanent resident seeking a replacement or renewed card

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
What is your mailing address?
In which country were you born?
What type of permanent resident card do you have?
fields.help: Describe the card, such as a 10-year or 2-year card. If unsure, enter Not sure.

fields.label: Why are you seeking a new card?
fields.help: For example: expiration, loss, damage, or a name correction. This answer does not establish eligibility.

forms.subject: U.S. citizen petitioner and their foreign fiancé(e) or spouse

fields.label: What is the U.S. petitioner's full legal name?
What is the petitioner's date of birth?
What is the petitioner's mailing address?
What is the beneficiary's full legal name?
fields.help: The beneficiary is the fiancé(e) or spouse for whom the petition is prepared.

fields.label: What is the beneficiary's date of birth?
How are the petitioner and beneficiary related?
fields.help: Describe whether they are engaged or married; the correct path needs review.

fields.label: Where does the beneficiary currently live?
fields.help: Enter city and country.

forms.subject: Petitioner sponsoring a family member and the family-member beneficiary

fields.label: What is the petitioner's full legal name?
What is the petitioner's date of birth?
What is the petitioner's citizenship or immigration status?
fields.help: Use a plain-language description. Do not enter document numbers.

fields.label: What is the petitioner's mailing address?
What is the family member's full legal name?
fields.help: This family member is the beneficiary.

fields.label: What is the beneficiary's date of birth?
How is the beneficiary related to the petitioner?
fields.help: For example: spouse, parent, child, or sibling.

forms.subject: Spouse beneficiary of the related I-130 petition

fields.label: What is the spouse beneficiary's full legal name?
fields.help: These answers concern the spouse beneficiary, not the I-130 petitioner.

fields.label: What is the spouse beneficiary's date of birth?
Where does the spouse beneficiary currently live?
fields.help: Include the full physical address, including country.

fields.label: When did the spouse beneficiary begin living there?
What is the spouse beneficiary's current employer?
fields.help: Enter Unemployed, Student, or Retired if appropriate.

fields.label: What is the spouse beneficiary's current occupation?
fields.help: If not working, describe the current situation.

fields.label: What is the I-130 petitioner's full legal name?

forms.subject: Person seeking a travel, parole, or arrival/departure document

fields.label: What is the document applicant's full legal name?
What is the applicant's date of birth?
What is the applicant's mailing address?
Where is the applicant currently located?
fields.help: Enter city and country.

fields.label: Which document or request are you preparing?
fields.help: Use the name identified in your instructions, or enter Not sure. I-131 covers several different requests.

fields.label: What is the purpose of the request?
fields.help: Briefly describe the travel or parole need. This draft does not determine whether travel is permitted.

fields.label: What travel or request dates are planned?
fields.help: Enter approximate dates or Not yet planned; do not invent a date.

forms.subject: Person outside the United States requesting carrier documentation

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
Where are you staying outside the United States?
When did you last depart the United States?
When do you intend to travel to the United States?
Which travel or residence document is affected?
fields.help: Describe the document type only. Do not enter its number.

fields.label: What happened to the document?
fields.help: Briefly describe the loss, theft, damage, nonreceipt, or other issue.

forms.subject: Individual declaring financial support and the intended beneficiary

fields.label: What is the supporting individual's full legal name?
fields.help: If preparing a declaration about your own support, identify yourself.

fields.label: What is the supporting individual's date of birth?
What is the supporting individual's mailing address?
What is the beneficiary's full legal name?
What is the relationship between supporter and beneficiary?
fields.help: Enter Self if the declaration is about your own support.

fields.label: What is the purpose of the beneficiary's intended temporary stay?
What support is intended during that stay?
fields.help: Describe housing or living-expense support in general terms. Do not enter bank account numbers.

forms.subject: Person applying for permanent residence or adjustment of status

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
In which country were you born?
Where do you currently live?
fields.help: Include the full physical address.

fields.label: What is your mailing address?
What is the stated basis for your permanent-residence application?
fields.help: Use the path already identified for your case, or enter Not sure. Do not guess a legal category.

fields.label: How would you describe your current immigration status?
fields.help: Use words only, without passport, A-number, or receipt numbers.

forms.subject: Conditional permanent resident seeking to remove residence conditions

fields.label: What is the conditional resident's full legal name?
What is the conditional resident's date of birth?
What is the conditional resident's mailing address?
What is the full name of the spouse through whom residence was obtained?
fields.help: Include a former or deceased spouse's name where applicable.

fields.label: On what date did that marriage begin?
What is the conditional green card's expiration date?
How do you expect to file this petition?
fields.help: Describe a joint filing, a requested waiver, or Not sure. This introductory draft does not assess the basis.

forms.subject: Person requesting employment authorization

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
What is your mailing address?
In which country were you born?
Is this an initial request, renewal, or replacement?
fields.help: Enter Not sure if the request type has not been confirmed.

fields.label: What is the basis for your work-authorization request?
fields.help: Use the category already identified for your case, or enter Not sure. No category is selected for you here.

fields.label: How would you describe your current immigration status?
fields.help: Do not enter identification or receipt numbers.

forms.subject: I-765 applicant preparing a requested economic-need worksheet

fields.label: What is the I-765 applicant's full legal name?
What is your current annual income?
fields.help: For this draft, use a sample amount in U.S. dollars; enter 0 if none.

fields.label: What are your current annual expenses?
fields.help: Use a sample annual amount in U.S. dollars.

fields.label: What is the total value of your assets?
fields.help: Use a sample amount in U.S. dollars. Do not include account numbers.

fields.label: How would you describe your current work situation?
fields.help: For example: employed, unemployed, student, or other.

fields.label: How would you explain your economic need to work?
fields.help: Describe income, expenses, and circumstances in general terms. This is an introductory worksheet draft.

forms.subject: Person requesting Temporary Protected Status

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
What is your mailing address?
In which country were you born?
What is your country of nationality?
fields.help: If you do not have a nationality, describe your country of last habitual residence.

fields.label: Is this an initial TPS request or a re-registration?
fields.help: Enter Not sure if you need the request type reviewed.

fields.label: When did you most recently arrive in the United States?

forms.subject: Person requesting consideration of deferred action under DACA

fields.label: What is your full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
What is your mailing address?
In which country were you born?
Is this an initial request or a renewal?
fields.help: This is for organizing a draft only. Current acceptance and processing rules require separate review.

fields.label: When did you first come to live in the United States?
What is your current education or work situation?
fields.help: Describe it generally. This answer is not an eligibility assessment.

forms.subject: Financial sponsor, including a petitioner sponsor or joint sponsor

fields.label: What is the sponsor's full legal name?
What is the sponsor's date of birth?
What is the sponsor's mailing address?
What is the sponsor's role in this case?
fields.help: For example: petitioning sponsor or joint sponsor. Enter Not sure if needed.

fields.label: What is the principal intending immigrant's full legal name?
What is the sponsor's relationship to the intending immigrant?
What are the sponsor's current income sources?
fields.help: Describe employment, self-employment, or other sources without account numbers or tax identifiers.

forms.subject: Household member contributing resources under a contract with the I-864 sponsor

fields.label: What is the household member's full legal name?
fields.help: These answers start with the contributing household member, not the I-864 sponsor.

fields.label: What is the household member's date of birth?
What is the household member's physical address?
What is the I-864 sponsor's full legal name?
How is the household member related to the sponsor?
fields.help: Describe the relationship; any qualifying household-member rules need separate review.

fields.label: What is the principal intending immigrant's full legal name?
What income or assets does the household member intend to make available?
fields.help: Describe sources generally. Do not enter bank account or tax-identification numbers.

forms.subject: Permanent resident applying for naturalization

fields.label: What is your current full legal name?
What is your date of birth?
In which country were you born?
Where do you currently live?
What is your mailing address?
What is the Resident Since date on your green card?
What naturalization basis has been identified for your case?
fields.help: Use a confirmed basis, or enter Not sure. This draft does not select an eligibility rule.

forms.subject: Holder of a naturalization or citizenship document needing a replacement or correction

fields.label: What is your current full legal name?
What name appears on the existing document?
fields.help: If the document is unavailable and you cannot confirm the name, enter Not sure.

fields.label: What is your date of birth?
What is your mailing address?
Which document do you want replaced or corrected?
fields.help: Enter the document type, such as Certificate of Naturalization. Do not enter its number.

fields.label: Why do you need a replacement or correction?
fields.help: Describe the issue generally, such as loss, damage, or a name change.

fields.label: Where and approximately when was the document issued?
fields.help: Use approximate information or Not sure if the details are unavailable.

forms.subject: Person whose citizenship through a parent is being documented

fields.label: What is the full legal name of the person seeking the certificate?
fields.help: If a parent completes this draft for a child, enter the child's name here.

fields.label: What is that person's date of birth?
In which country was that person born?
Where does that person currently live?
What mailing address should be used for this draft?
What is the full legal name of the parent through whom citizenship is claimed?
fields.help: If the claim involves both parents, include both names.

fields.label: How and when did that parent become a U.S. citizen?
fields.help: Describe known facts or enter Not sure. This introductory draft does not determine citizenship.

fields.label: Who is completing this draft?
fields.help: For example: the person seeking the certificate, a parent, or a legal guardian.
